title: Proper Scoring Rule-based Diffusion for Probabilistic Weather Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2609.38632v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent probabilistic weather forecasters train stochastic predictors with the continuous ranked probability score (CRPS) to generate each ensemble member in a single forward pass. These models learn the predictive distribution from the forecast context alone, which becomes difficult at longer forecast horizons where uncertainty is high. To learn the predictive distribution more effectively, we introduce auxiliary conditional denoising tasks that predict the same future state from the context and its corrupted version, which provides partial future information that can reduce prediction ambiguity. Building on distributional diffusion models, we learn the conditional distributions of these tasks with a single stochastic predictor by minimizing a proper scoring rule across noise levels. translated_title: 基于适当评分规则的扩散模型用于概率天气预报
translated_abstract: 近期的概率天气预报模型使用连续排名概率评分（CRPS）训练随机预测器，从而在单次前向传播中生成每个集合成员。这些模型仅从预报上下文中学习预测分布，这在预报时效较长、不确定性较高的场景下变得困难。为了更有效地学习预测分布，我们引入了辅助条件去噪任务，即从上下文及其损坏版本预测相同的未来状态，其中损坏版本提供了部分未来信息，能够降低预测的模糊性。在分布式扩散模型的基础上，我们通过在不同噪声水平上最小化适当评分规则，使用单个随机预测器来学习这些任务的条件分布。在推理阶段，预测器仍然可以在完全损坏的端点上以单次前向传播生成每个集合成员。标准的CRPS训练可……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于适当评分规则的分布式扩散训练框架，通过引入利用部分未来信息的辅助条件去噪任务来提升长预报时效下的概率天气预报效果，同时保持推理时单次前向传播即可生成集合成员的高效性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a proper scoring rule-based diffusion training framework that introduces auxiliary conditional denoising tasks leveraging partial future information to improve probabilistic weather forecasting at long horizons, while still generating each ensemble member in a single forward pass.
